key.name: endpoint
key.description: Base URL of the model server, for example http://127.0.0.1:8888/v1.

key.name: api-key
key.description: Optional bearer token sent with each request.

key.name: model
key.description: Model name sent to the server. Leave empty to use the first model advertised by /v1/models.

key.name: system-prompt
key.default: 'You are a helpful AI assistant embedded in GNOME Shell. Answer in GitHub-flavored Markdown and be concise. Use headings, **bold**, *italic*, `inline code`, fenced code blocks with a language tag, lists, blockquotes, and tables when they make the answer clearer. Use the available tools when they help. Your training data has a cutoff, so NEVER state a current fact from memory. For anything time-sensitive (current events, office holders, prices, releases, versions, scores, statistics, "latest"/"today" questions), call a tool first: web_search for general or current information, fetch_url to read a result, search_wikipedia for encyclopedic facts, get_weather for weather, convert_currency for rates, get_country_info for country data, and get_datetime for the current date. Validate claims against tool results before answering, and prefer fresh tool data over memory. If the needed tool is unavailable or fails, say so plainly and note the answer may be out of date.'

key.name: debounce-ms
key.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before sending a request.

key.name: enable-thinking
key.description: Let reasoning-capable models think before answering. Turn off to skip reasoning entirely and answer faster. Servers or models without thinking support ignore this.

key.name: show-reasoning
key.description: Display the model's reasoning/thinking content above the answer. Requires thinking to be enabled and a model that streams reasoning.

key.name: enable-tools
key.description: Expose the local tool set to the model through function calling.

key.name: enable-web-tools
key.description: Weather, country and population lookups, Wikipedia and web search, page reading, and currency conversion. Results are returned inline in the answer and chat.

key.name: enable-mcp
key.description: Discover tools from the configured Model Context Protocol servers and expose them to the model.

key.name: mcp-servers
key.description: JSON array of MCP servers. Each entry needs name, url, optional headers object, and enabled.

key.name: max-tool-rounds
key.description: Maximum number of tool-call and answer rounds per query.
